question.problem:
The rolls of an unfair octahedral die follow the probability mass function $f(x)$ as shown in the table below. What is the expected value of one roll of the die?

| $x$ | $1$ | $2$ | $3$ | $4$ | $5$ | $6$ | $7$ | $8$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{16}$ | $\frac{1}{16}$ | $\frac{3}{32}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{32}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ |
question.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3)+4\cdot f(4)+5\cdot f(5)+6\cdot f(6) \\  & =1(\frac{1}{8})+2(\frac{1}{16})+3(\frac{1}{16})+4(\frac{3}{32})+5(\frac{1}{8})+6(\frac{1}{32})+7(\frac{1}{4})+8(\frac{1}{4}) \\  & =\frac{1}{8}+\frac{2}{16}+\frac{3}{16}+\frac{12}{32}+\frac{5}{8}+\frac{6}{32}+\frac{7}{4}+\frac{8}{4} \\  & =\frac{4}{32}+\frac{4}{32}+\frac{6}{32}+\frac{12}{32}+\frac{20}{32}+\frac{6}{32}+\frac{56}{32}+\frac{64}{32} \\  & =\frac{4+4+6+12+20+6+56+64}{32} \\  & =\frac{172}{32} \\  & =\frac{43}{8}.\end{aligned}
$$
